programs.title: Crime Beat
programs.desc: What was meant to be a joyful night celebrating her 32nd birthday turned into tragedy when Mohanie Henry Khan's husband, Peter Khan, was shot. Despite desperately trying to stop the bleeding, she couldn't save him. Now, for the first time, she sits down with reporter Catherine McDonald to share the full story-revealing what happened that fateful night, why Peter wasn't the only victim, and how investigators ultimately tracked down his killer.
